name: @marcix/myicons
description: MyIcons: the full icon pack for mypgs, as inline SVG masks.

scripts.build: npm run sync && sass scss/index.scss dist/icons.css --no-source-map && sass scss/index.scss dist/icons.min.css --no-source-map --style=compressed
scripts.syncmaster: git fetch origin && git checkout master && git pull --ff-only origin master && git merge --no-edit origin/dev && git push origin master && git checkout dev
scripts.syncmaster:commit: printf 'Merge message: ' && IFS= read -r merge_message && test -n "$merge_message" && git fetch origin && git checkout master && git pull --ff-only origin master && git merge --no-ff origin/dev -m "$merge_message" && git push origin master && git checkout dev
